recognize_zh: TdT 核染色只在小葉周邊（上方）的皮質區呈密集棕色核陽性，中央髓質區與甲狀腺濾泡為陰性，這種皮質／髓質分區的 TdT 分布是正常胸腺的特徵。
features: Dense nuclear TdT positivity confined to the peripheral (cortical) portions of the thymic lobules
Paler central lymphoid zone largely TdT-negative, corresponding to medulla
Sharp, compartmentalized boundary between TdT-positive and TdT-negative regions
Small scattered clusters of TdT-positive cells at the lobule edges
Adjacent thyroid follicles and adipose tissue negative; linear fold artifacts present
describe_en: TdT immunohistochemistry shows strong nuclear staining of densely packed lymphocytes restricted to the outer cortical regions of the lymphoid lobules, while the central medullary zones and a larger peripheral lymphoid area are negative. The adjacent thyroid follicles are negative. This zonal cortex-predominant distribution of immature TdT-positive T cells reflects normal thymic organization rather than an infiltrative lymphoblastic process. Findings are consistent with a cervical thymic remnant with intermixed ectopic thyroid tissue.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblastic lymphoma shows diffuse, sheet-like TdT positivity that ignores and effaces the cortex-medulla boundary, whereas here TdT is compartmentalized to cortex with an intact epithelial framework.

Thymoma also contains TdT-positive immature T cells but forms an encapsulated mass with abnormal lobulation and expanded epithelium, rather than a small organized remnant with normal cortex-medulla ratio.
Indolent T-lymphoblastic proliferation occurs outside the thymus without an epithelial meshwork, whereas here the TdT-positive cells sit within CK5/6/p63-positive thymic epithelium.
